capabilities: Enforce a write-forward mode where Backspace and Delete apply strikethroughs instead of erasing
Add color-coded highlights and strikethroughs with comments via a selection popup or popover
List all annotations in a sidebar with cards synced to the editor scroll position
Pin notes to positions in the text as separate markdown files
Insert quad indentation blocks with Tab on the last line
extras: Manual installation only (copying files into .obsidian/plugins); the manifest warns the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted to preserve the messy, authentic process of thinking and writing that backspacing normally erases.
problem: Obsidian's editor erases deleted text, so the messy process of how an idea evolved is lost while writing.

relations.evidence: This plugin was built on top of ideas from jancbeck/obsidian-note-annotations.

summary: Write-forward editor mode that turns deletions into strikethroughs, plus color-coded highlights and an annotation sidebar.
